action_items: (Carried from iter 8) Refactor /app/frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.js (now 2146 lines) — split Book-Setup, Dictation, AI-Editor, Audio-Studio into separate components/hooks per code-review note.

Optional: add a dedicated frontend Playwright test for the dictation-history undo/clear UI by directly seeding React state (requires test-only hook or harness route) — current functional gate (panel hidden when dictationHistory.length === 0) is verified by DOM-absence assertion.
critical_code_review_comments: EditorPage.js: the new continuousMode + dictationHistory state lives alongside ~30 other useStates in a single 2146-line component. Splitting into useDictation() hook + <DictationHistoryPanel /> + <DictateToolbar /> would isolate the 30s recorder-cycle (_startRecorderCycle) timer logic which currently runs inline.

Recording cycle: ensure mediaRecorder.onstop cleanup runs on component unmount mid-recording (e.g., navigating away) so MediaStream tracks are stopped — verify navigator.mediaDevices stream tracks are stop()-ed in useEffect cleanup, otherwise mic indicator can persist after route change. Could not exercise this functionally in headless (no mic), so this is a code-review only finding.

Toast on mic failure resolves to 'Requested device not found' (browser DOMException message). Wrapping the catch block to map common DOMException names (NotFoundError → 'Microphone not available', NotAllowedError → 'Microphone permission denied', NotReadableError → 'Microphone in use by another app') would give clearer UX than echoing the raw browser string.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (14/14 Playwright checks: register + testid presence x7 + history-panel-absent + toggle-state-flip + no-crash + mic-error-toast + meta-save-toast + cover-upload-flow)
